meta.title: Sci-Hub PDF Fetcher
meta.description: Adds the scihub_pdf and scihub_batch tools: take a DOI or an article/PDF URL (or a list of DOIs), resolve them through Sci-Hub mirrors, download the paper PDFs and save them into the session workspace. The mirror list lives in lib/mirrors.json and can be refreshed with `node update-mirrors.mjs`.
